items.title: Announcing 30-minute timeout for on-demand AWS Lambda Event Functions
items.summary: AWS Lambda now supports a 30-minute function timeout for on-demand Event Functions and for synchronous invocations on Lambda Managed Instances, doubling the previous 15-minute limit. You can run AI inference, media transcoding, and other long-running jobs without re-architecting your applications.
items.creator: Tarun Rai Madan

items.title: AWS Lambda Durable Functions observability with OpenTelemetry
items.summary: A single AWS Lambda Durable Functions workflow can span many invocations, fragmenting its traces. This post shows how the OpenTelemetry plugin for the AWS Durable Execution SDK generates deterministic trace IDs that unify every invocation into one distributed trace, and how to set it up, read the traces, and apply best practices.
items.creator: Ricardo Marques
